title: OS Command Injection via User Input in InputValidationsOSCMDInjectionMain2Activity
rationale: In `InputValidationsOSCMDInjectionMain2Activity.java`, the method `onCreate$lambda$0` constructs a command string `ip1` by concatenating 'ping ' with text directly from an `EditText` (`$ip.getText()`). This string is then passed to `Runtime.getRuntime().exec(ip1)`, which allows an attacker to append arbitrary shell commands (e.g., '; ls') through the input field.
suggested_next_steps: Trace the origin of `$ip` to confirm it is user-controllable via UI.
Check if any sanitization or validation is performed on the input before concatenation.
